LanguageData.LP_LegendRespecStone.label: legend reforging stone
LanguageData.LP_LegendRespecStone.description: A dark faceted crystal with gold light flowing in its cracks. When a legendary adventurer crushes it, all legend points spent in the past are refunded and can be reassigned. Only legendary adventurers can use it; those who never spent points cannot.\n\nCannot be crafted. Nemesis champions sometimes carry one, Black Network caravans occasionally stock it, and Larloch also gives it as a reward.
